citation.authors: Mahe A, Ly F, Aymard G, Dangou JM

record.population: 425 women who used bleaching products, plus 368 women screened, in Dakar, Senegal
record.design: Cross-sectional clinic study with examination and analysis of product samples
record.finding: 52.7% of 368 women questioned were current users. Users reported hydroquinone (89%), glucocorticoids (70%), mercury iodide (10%) and caustic agents (17%). Hydroquinone in analysed samples was 4% to 8.7%. The main skin problems in users included dermatophyte infections (105 women) and scabies (69).
